name: Knight of Lelouch
source:
Suzaku studies alongside Lelouch. At first he dislikes the guy and the company of friends around him. However, after a certain incident it turns out that there is much in common between them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
朱雀与鲁路修在同一所学校读书。起初，他既不喜欢鲁路修，也不喜欢围在他身边的朋友们。然而，某件事发生后，他发现两人其实有许多共同点。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]］
